description: This file contains shell functions to analyze and determine the filesystem type of a given image or device using magic words and padding markers. It includes functions for extracting magic words, checking for specific filesystem markers, and computing aligned sizes.

methods.name: get_magic_word
methods.description: Reads the first four bytes of a specified file/device and outputs their hexadecimal representation.

methods.name: get_post_padding_word
methods.description: Calculates the post padding word from the end of a root filesystem image if conditions are met.

methods.name: get_fs_type
methods.description: Determines the filesystem type based on magic words and padding markers.

methods.name: round_up
methods.description: Calculates the smallest multiple of a given size greater than or equal to a number.
